SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.class_code as classCode, c.category_code as categoryCode, c.name, c.price, c.desired_price as desiredPrice, c.address, c.star_rating_avg as starRatingAvg, c.single_introduce as singleIntroduce, (SELECT ci.image FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.class_code = c.class_code AND ci.sort_order = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS c
AND c.status = '모집중'
AND (c.category_code = #{categoryCode} OR c.category_code IN (SELECT category_code FROM CATEGORY WHERE parents_category = #{categoryCode}))
ORDER BY c.star_rating_avg DESC NULLS LAST, c.class_code DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limitCount}

SELECT c.class_code as classCode, c.category_code as categoryCode, c.name, c.price, c.desired_price as desiredPrice, c.address, c.star_rating_avg as starRatingAvg, c.single_introduce as singleIntroduce, (SELECT ci.image FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.class_code = c.class_code AND ci.sort_order = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS c
AND c.status = '모집중'
AND (c.category_code = #{categoryCode} OR c.category_code IN (SELECT category_code FROM CATEGORY WHERE parents_category = #{categoryCode}))
ORDER BY c.star_rating_avg DESC NULLS LAST, c.class_code DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.class_code as classCode, c.category_code as categoryCode, c.name, c.price, c.desired_price as desiredPrice, c.address, c.star_rating_avg as starRatingAvg, c.single_introduce as singleIntroduce, (SELECT ci.image FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.class_code = c.class_code AND ci.sort_order = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS c JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON c.class_code = r.class_code JOIN SCHEDULE s ON r.repeat_rule_code = s.repeat_rule_code WHERE c.status = '모집중' AND TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND s.sold_out_yn = 'N' AND s.remaining_people > 0

SELECT DISTINCT c.class_code as classCode, c.category_code as categoryCode, c.name, c.price, c.desired_price as desiredPrice, c.address, c.star_rating_avg as starRatingAvg, c.single_introduce as singleIntroduce, (SELECT ci.image FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.class_code = c.class_code AND ci.sort_order = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS c JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON c.class_code = r.class_code JOIN SCHEDULE s ON r.repeat_rule_code = s.repeat_rule_code WHERE c.status = '모집중' AND TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=AMERICAN') IN ('SAT', 'SUN') AND s.class_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND s.sold_out_yn = 'N' AND s.remaining_people > 0

SELECT DISTINCT c.class_code as classCode, c.category_code as categoryCode, c.name, c.price, c.desired_price as desiredPrice, c.address, c.star_rating_avg as starRatingAvg, c.single_introduce as singleIntroduce, (SELECT ci.image FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.class_code = c.class_code AND ci.sort_order = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS c JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON c.class_code = r.class_code JOIN SCHEDULE s ON r.repeat_rule_code = s.repeat_rule_code
AND c.status = '모집중'
AND (c.category_code = #{categoryCode} OR c.category_code IN (SELECT category_code FROM CATEGORY WHERE parents_category = #{categoryCode}))
AND TRUNC(s.class_date) = TRUNC(#{scheduleDTO.date})
AND s.start_time >= #{scheduleDTO.startTime}
AND s.sold_out_yn = 'N' AND s.remaining_people > 0
SELECT class_img_code as classImgCode, class_code as classCode, type, image, sort_order as sortOrder FROM CLASS_IMG WHERE class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT category_code as categoryCode, name as categoryName, parents_category as parentCategoryCode FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY category_code ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS WHERE ADDRESS LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND STATUS = '모집중'
